summary: The approved Calc XLSX file path meets its deterministic and behavioral checks in the existing document model and UI.
findings: The Strict and Transitional source fixtures, active document admission guards, ODS persistence and downloaded files are covered by actual round trips. The complete compiler and original conditional-format profiles each meet all scoped90 thresholds.
The production suite covers desktop and mobile Calc with actual workbook download/reopen, and the shared package suite passes 211 cases.
residual_risks: Data bars and icon sets are outside the represented Calc core. Upstream extended-rule ordering and ODS conversion semantics are documented as CALC-767 through CALC-769.
